function code() {
	cd $ROOT

	# Node modules
	test -d node_modules || npm i

	# Configuration
	export NODE_ENV=development

	# Launch Code
	if [[ "$OSTYPE" == "darwin"* ]]; then
		exec ./.build/electron/Electron.app/Contents/MacOS/Electron . "$@"
	else
		exec ./.build/electron/electron . "$@"
	fi
}
